spatial_and_orientation_analysis: In both supplied reference and delivered image, a dark appliance lies left of the stove, with white shelving to its right and a mirror above the left appliance. The front-facing appliance doors and top burners provide orientation cues. Images supplied with task; /evidence/reference_gt/reference_instance_statistics.json:49-64,97-112,161-176,193-208; /evidence/final_source/build.py:30-63.

The candidate shows a wider room view, smaller appliances and extensive blank left background; the reference is tighter with larger appliances and a strongly cropped foreground. Camera pose, layout and crop jointly confound these differences; no aligned 3D error is established. Images supplied with task; /evidence/final_source/build.py:71-73.

The candidate shelf is exposed beside the stove, whereas the reference shelf is partly occluded by the stove; image overlap does not uniquely determine depth. The door panel is visible but its actual pivot and swing cannot be inferred reliably from one image. Images supplied with task; /evidence/final_source/build.py:52-57,64-67.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The reference gold tile has mottled surface variation; the candidate uses discrete flat randomly colored tile meshes and appears lighter and more uniform. /evidence/final_source/build.py:8-10,24-28; supplied images.

For walnut floor the Generated coordinate output is multiplied by (2,28,3), passed through Noise scale 4 and a color ramp into the Principled Base Color; floor mesh is bound to that material. This produces stretched pattern in generated-coordinate space, not a direct measurement of physical grain alignment. /evidence/final_source/build.py:6-12,14-15,22; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1.

The mirror has a metallic Principled material and two separate white rectangles simulating reflected cabinetry rather than reconstructing the detailed reference reflection. /evidence/final_source/build.py:58-63; original inventory:493-496; supplied images.

No external image load is present in executed source; evaluator reports no missing external images. Source uses geometry and procedural materials, not a full-reference image plane. /evidence/executions/blender_1795841692942277709/code/build.py:1-80; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/summary.json:7.
geometry_analysis: The front island countertop is a standalone slab at z 0.85-0.95, with no support created beneath it in the source, and appears floating in the delivered image. /evidence/final_source/build.py:68-71; /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:503; supplied candidate image. This is an observable simplified structure, not an aligned GT error.

The shelf bottom is at approximately z 0.278 and side bottoms at z 0.29, above the floor top z 0; its support is not shown in source. /evidence/independent_evaluation/original_inspection/capture/original/object_inventory.jsonl:1,485-492. Bounding values do not alone establish physical support or collisions.

The panel and two inset boxes are independent unparented objects; a dark box represents doorway darkness and there is no demonstrated articulated hinge test. /evidence/final_source/build.py:64-67; original inventory:497-500.
